description: This PHP file defines a controller class for managing a Blog module in the Opencart admin panel. It handles rendering the module configuration interface, saving settings, adding, and deleting module instances.

classes.name: Blog
classes.description: Controller class for Blog module in Opencart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the configuration page for the Blog module, setting up breadcrumbs, loading module data if editing, and preparing the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the module configuration, performs permission checks, validates input, and saves or updates the module data.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Creates a new Blog module instance with default settings and returns success or error message.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specified Blog module instance if the user has permission.
